notes.title: Patch Note 0.10 - Better UI, Visibility, Readybility, New Tutorial and more
notes.content:
[h2][b]SUM UP[/b][/h2][list][*][p]A menu with many new options[/p][/*][*][p]Game Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Heat Tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Display of planet multipliers[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visibility of your own rocket[/p][/*][*][p]Improved readability of the scoreboard[/p][/*][*][p]English and French language support[/p][/*][/list][previewyoutube="9nsJgDysHoI;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2][b]IN DETAIL[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Display of zone multipliers[/p][list][*][p]Ability to show or hide zones, text, and sound independently[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Option to better see your rocket[/p][/*][*][p]Option to less see other people’s rockets (you’ll still see rockets achieving a high score)[/p][list][*][p]Option to not fade rockets launched from your own stream via Heat (Twitch)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Sound changes and options to enable/disable various sound effects[/p][/*][*][p]Link to the new Instagram and Bluesky accounts (feel free to follow ♥)[/p][/*][*][p]Leaderboard[/p][list][*][p]Blue display of the rocket with the best flight time (if outside the top 3)[/p][/*][*][p]Local player rocket in the replay even if not in the top 100[/p][/*][*][p]Column alignment[/p][/*][*][p]Option to underline your score[/p][/*][*][p]Option to reduce the number of rows displayed (Top 10* / Top 3*)
*[i] In addition to the Top 10 or Top 3, you’ll always see the rocket with the best time even if it’s not in the top, as well as your own score and the player in front and the player behind you[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Rockets score[/p][list][*][p]Separate score display options for your rocket or those of others[/p][/*][*][p]Always be able to display rocket details at the top of the leaderboard*
*[i] In addition to the Top 3, you’ll also see the rocket beating the best time even if it’s not in the Top 3[/i][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]For Twitch streamers[/p][list][*][p]Attempt to stabilize the Heat connection[/p][/*][*][p]Attempt to improve the Twitch connection[/p][/*][*][p]Heat tutorial[/p][list][*][p]And option to automate its display when an Anonymous player joins the game[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Option to show/hide the rules that scroll at the bottom of the screen[/p][/*][*][p]Option still hidden but Accessible: CTRL+B = to remove the background:[/p][list][*][p]In the game, you’ll see the background disappear and become black.[/p][/*][*][p]On OBS, you can take a « Game Capture » and « Allow Transparency » in its properties.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h2][b]WHAT'S NEXT ?[/b][/h2][p align="start"]I still have many improvements I want to make. These include, but are not limited to:[/p][list][*][p]Daily Maps[/p][/*][*][p]Displaying a podium at the end of the game[/p][/*][*][p]Being able to play with a keyboard/controller[/p][/*][*][p]Transforming the Heatmap into a constellation[/p][/*][*][p]Translating into more languages[/p][/*][*][p]…[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Steam Demo Available!
notes.content:
[h1][b]The Steam demo is now available![/b][/h1]
This is just the beginning — many exciting updates are coming in the next weeks and months!

[h2]What's available[/h2]
You can play the game in [b]Solo[/b] mode (New Game)
or join the [b]Public Game[/b] (Join Public Game)

If you're a [b]streamer[/b], you can link your account to Twitch and add the Heat extension so your viewers can play [b]by clicking directly on your stream[/b]!

[i]If you're playing in the public game, you can also link your Twitch username so it's the one shown in-game.[/i]



[h2]Next priorities[/h2]
[list]
[*] Add skin selection (and a special unlockable Demo skin)
[*] Add a podium at the end of the game
[*] Redesign the UI
[*] Game Localization (multi-language support)
[*] Image-based tutorial
[*] Create/Join Private Games
[*] And more on the [url=https://trello.com/b/marvlhBt/cosmic-drift-road-map]Road Map[/url] (only in French)
[/list]

Thanks so much for your feedback, for sharing the game around, and for playing ♥
